text: Cancelling the subscription stops the next renewal but the unused credit promised by the policy never appears.
The dashboard total is correct in the API, but the final digit is clipped at the browser default font size.
A CSV with accented customer names imports without errors, but those names become question marks in the stored records.
Keyboard focus disappears when the navigation drawer opens. The underlying account and data remain accessible by mouse.
My monthly plan renewed once but the statement contains two settled charges with different payment references.
A viewer can change another team member to administrator. This happens through both the API and the settings screen.
The nightly export silently omits rows created during the last minute of the day. The same rows are visible in the app.
After signing in successfully, opening a second tab sends me back to the login page. Invoice downloads work once I sign in again.
